edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC11 Activity retried or timed out
    Given an activity of the conductCheck branch fails or does not finish inside its timeout
    When the workflow runs the activity again
    Then the retry follows the workflow's own schedule, no finding is recorded until the activity completes and the entry is written once

  Scenario: AC12 Status change not allowed
    Given a partner or an instruction reads a status from which the model does not allow the requested change
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused and no status moves
